question: How does the per-epoch C_t pre-image cloud size vary across the LC on seed 89, and is selectivity driven by brightness or geometry?
hypothesis: Dim epochs are more constrained (smaller C_t); the per-epoch pre-image filter is a usable q-prior with truth always retained.
narrative_md: v1-surrogate sweep of per-epoch C_t cloud size on seed 89: |C_t| varies 60x across the LC, and selectivity is geometry-dominated, not brightness-dominated (mag 14.86 -> 1.3k survivors vs mag 14.38 -> 75k). Truth-q survives at every probed epoch but nearest-sample distance can grow to 9.59 deg at thin-slice geometries. v1 is ~12x faster than v2 (4.5 vs 56 us/sample), the right choice for C_t sampling. Reads truth-q nearest distances as the diagnostic.
